title: Value at the biased probability level
statement: Let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $\alpha\in(0,1)$. There is a uniquely specified probability parameter in $(0,1)$ at which the biased minus-probability polynomial of $f$ equals $\alpha$; at that parameter, the polynomial indeed has value $\alpha$.
